title: Power BI Sample Quiz (all question types)
description: Twelve original practice questions that show every question type: multiple choice, multiple response, true/false, match, yes/no and order.
instructions: Multiple-choice questions have one best answer unless they say Select two.
Match questions: choose an answer from the drop-down next to each item.
Order questions: use the arrows to put the steps in order, first at the top.

questions.text: In Power Query, which feature stacks the rows of two tables that have the same columns into one table?
questions.explanation: Append Queries adds the rows of one table under another. Merge Queries joins tables side by side on matching columns.

questions.text: Which storage mode leaves the data in the source system and sends a query to it each time a visual needs data?
questions.explanation: DirectQuery does not copy the data into the model; each visual queries the source when it is rendered.

questions.text: Which TWO actions reduce the size of a model that uses Import mode? (Select two.)
options: Remove columns that no report or measure uses
Turn on Auto date/time for every table
Split a date-time column into separate date and time columns
Add a calculated column for every measure
questions.explanation: Fewer columns and lower cardinality compress better. Auto date/time adds hidden date tables, and extra calculated columns add storage.

questions.text: Which DAX function evaluates an expression in a modified filter context?
questions.explanation: CALCULATE is the main function for changing filter context, for example to ignore or add filters.

questions.text: Match each DAX function to what it does.
pairs: Evaluates an expression in a modified filter context
Returns a table with only the rows that meet a condition
Returns all rows of a table, ignoring any filters
Returns a value from the related table on the one side of a relationship
distractors: Converts a text value to a number
questions.explanation: One answer is not used: converting text to a number is done by VALUE.

questions.text: Put the steps to build and share a report in the correct order.
steps: Clean and shape the data in Power Query
Create relationships and measures in the model
Build the visuals on the report canvas
Publish the report to a workspace in the Power BI service
questions.explanation: Data is prepared before it is modelled, and the model must exist before visuals can use it.

questions.text: For each statement, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.
pairs: A star schema keeps facts and dimensions in separate tables.
Row-level security roles can be defined in Power BI Desktop.
A calculated column is recalculated every time a user changes a slicer.
questions.explanation: Calculated columns are computed when the data is refreshed, not when report filters change.

questions.text: Which visual is the best choice to show how a value changes over a continuous date range?
questions.explanation: Line charts show trends over continuous time. Pie charts show parts of a whole at one point.

questions.text: Put the steps to set up row-level security (RLS) in the correct order.
steps: Create a role in Power BI Desktop
Add a DAX filter expression to the role
Test the role with View as
Publish the report to the Power BI service
Assign users or groups to the role in the Power BI service
questions.explanation: Roles are defined and tested in Desktop; members are assigned after publishing.

questions.text: A Date table and a Sales table are related on the date column. What is the usual cardinality from Date to Sales?
questions.explanation: Each date appears once in the Date table and many times in the Sales fact table.

questions.text: A Power BI dashboard can contain tiles pinned from more than one report.
questions.explanation: Dashboards can combine tiles pinned from several reports.

questions.text: An imported semantic model uses an on-premises SQL Server database. Which TWO are needed to refresh it automatically every day? (Select two.)
options: A scheduled refresh in the semantic model settings
Power BI Desktop left open on a laptop
A pie chart on every report page
questions.explanation: The gateway gives the service access to the on-premises source, and the schedule sets when refresh runs.
